# Show Me The Money

> Show Me The Money (showmethemoney.pro) is a free resource from Dreams Business Resources that helps business owners discover money already hiding inside their business — missed tax credits, payroll savings, group health overpayments, technology and energy savings, funding and growth opportunities — through a complimentary AI-powered business intelligence report called the DREAMS Score, plus a free interactive EBITDA business value calculator.

## What this site teaches

Most business owners are quietly losing six figures a year to missed tax credits, overpriced benefits, bloated expenses, and untapped growth. The DREAMS Score examines six areas of a business:

- **D — Debt & Corporate Funding**: access growth capital and restructure costly debt
- **R — Retirement & 401(k)**: optimize plans and protect tax-advantaged growth
- **E — Expense Reduction**: stop overpaying on benefits, energy and services
- **A — Asset Optimization**: turn marketing and AI into measurable ROI
- **M — Money & Tax Credits**: recover hidden R&D, FICA and payroll credits
- **S — Security & Protection**: close protection gaps and secure key people

## The EBITDA business value calculator

Every dollar of recurring savings permanently raises EBITDA, and a business is valued at a multiple of EBITDA. Visitors pick their industry (typical multiples range from 2.5x for restaurants to 6.5x for Technology & SaaS) and adjust six savings sliders: hidden tax credits (R&D), payroll tax savings (FICA tip credit), group health savings, technology and telecom savings, energy and utility savings, and additional recurring savings. Worked example: $368,700 in annual recurring savings ($30,725/month) at a 4.5x EBITDA multiple adds approximately $1,659,150 in increased business value.

## The toolbox behind the DREAMS Score

- **R&D Tax Credits**: recover unclaimed federal and state credits already earned
- **FICA Tip Tax Credit**: tipped businesses can recover $10K–$50K+ per year in employer-paid FICA, current year plus prior years
- **Trumark Health**: benefits that lower employer cost while increasing employee take-home pay and retention; zero out-of-pocket strategy with $600–$900 average annual tax savings per employee
- **DREAMS Technology Solutions**: cut telecom, cloud, and connectivity costs with vendor-neutral guidance
- **DREAMS AI Accelerator**: AI-powered marketing and content systems for measurable growth
- **Bank Breezy Funding**: revenue-based business funding based on revenue, not credit score
- **GOALL Program**: tax-advantaged, protected, tax-free retirement income and legacy
- **DREAMS Energy Resources**: lower utility, solar, and water costs by up to 40%

## Audience and call to action

The site is a referral page for business owners. Visitors are invited to watch a short video, run their own numbers in the calculator, and schedule a complimentary 15-minute DREAMS Score — no cost, no obligation — or get back with the person who referred them.

## About the publisher

Dreams Business Resources (DBR) builds effective virtual distribution teams in the financial services and B2B marketplace. Motto: One Relationship. Multiple Revenue Streams. Infinite Possibilities.
